Chapter 870: Chapter 13 ‘Real’ Myriad Realms Gate (Request for Subscription)

“Don’t underestimate the Galaxy Master.”

Tianyu Meng glanced at ‘Qu Li Xiao’, reminding him, “Human Civilization actually dares to let such a genius enter the battlefield, they must be prepared.”

After Tianyu Meng spoke, scenes of battle images appeared in front of him.

It was Lin Yuan entering the super-large battlefield and taking action multiple times.

Although Lin Yuan did not leave any survivors every time he made a move,

other than Tuoba Ancient God, the rest of the Alien Strong Ones were just avatars.

The original body shared memories with the avatars, and could restore the entire battle process through the memories of the original body.

“The main method of the Galaxy Master should be the Xuan Huang-colored domain ability.”

“This kind of ability is so powerful that it can suppress ordinary supreme weapons.”

“As long as it drags on, holders of supreme weapons at Level Eleven Perfect won’t be able to outlast it.”

Tianyu Meng watched the battle images, and as the battlefield commander of the Tianyu Grand Alliance, she always needed to pay attention to the intelligence information of strong figures from other peak power camps.

To make adjustments to the battle situation.

Aiming to use our strengths to attack their weaknesses.

What the Galaxy Master is best at is suppression and endurance battles.

Although it is unknown why the Galaxy Master can maintain such a level of Xuan Huang domain for a long time,

the ability mastered by ‘Qu Li Xiao’ can precisely counter such tactics.

Therefore, Tianyu Meng ultimately chose to let ‘Qu Li Xiao’ confront the Galaxy Master.

“The Xuan Huang domain is just one of the methods the Galaxy Master has shown, it doesn’t mean that the Galaxy Master only has this one method, understand?”

Tianyu Meng looked at ‘Qu Li Xiao’.

She knew of ‘Qu Li Xiao’s’ pride, hence her admonition.

In fact, like Tianyu Meng and Qu Li Xiao, such strongest Level Eleven Perfect individuals are the prepared candidates for their great peak clans to breach the ultimate.

Usually, they wouldn’t show themselves, all immersed in contemplating the breakthrough to the ultimate.

If it wasn’t for the super-large battlefield being so crucial, they wouldn’t have possibly spared the effort to enter the battlefield.

“I understand.”

Qu Li Xiao thought for a while and nodded, “Even if I can’t defeat the Galaxy Master, I can still hold them off. I don’t care about the other strong humans, but I can ensure that the Galaxy Master won’t be able to assist.”

“Just holding them off is enough.”

Tianyu Meng nodded in satisfaction, she viewed the Galaxy Master very highly.

If it wasn’t for Xuanyuan You being the direct disciple of a Xuanyuan Supreme, based on current intelligence, who poses a greater threat than the Galaxy Master,

She would definitely like to try challenging the Galaxy Master herself, and see what it feels like to face this unrivaled genius known across all great peak clans.

Next.

Tianyu Meng analyzed other evolved beings of the Human Civilization Alliance and accordingly arranged members of the Tianyu Grand Alliance to counter them.

“The Human Civilization Alliance is almost dealt with; it’s time for the Robber Clan!”

Tianyu Meng looked visibly more serious, and so did the other strong members of the Tianyu Grand Alliance.

While human civilization is powerful, the Robber Clan is even more unfathomable, being a suspected lineage from the previous Cosmic Era, the Robber Clan has the smallest number of members among the twelve peak clans.

The two Level Twelve Ultimate members of the Robber Clan are the most powerful among all the Level Twelve members in the universe, and they’ve probably reached the pinnacle of the ‘Path-Creating’ realm.

The Level Twelve Ultimate of the Robber Clan is incredibly powerful, and their warriors below Level Twelve can also sweep those of the same level.

In this super-large battlefield, the twelve peak clans have close to two thousand Level Eleven evolved human members, which is considered above average.

The number of Level Eleven Robber Clan powerhouses is the least, less than a hundred.

Even so, Tianyu Meng felt as if facing a great adversary, arranging herself and two other strongest Level Eleven members, along with dozens of Level Eleven Perfect, to jointly hold off the strongest Level Eleven of the Robber Clan.

“Luckily the Robber Clan members are few in number, otherwise even if we join hands with the other ten great peak forces, we might not be able to handle them.”

Tianyu Meng thought to herself, comparing to the special life forms nurtured by the universe, the Robber Clan members are much more difficult to deal with.

Every member of the Robber Clan has grown through endless calamities, their combat experience almost perfected, and the legacy of their secret techniques are also extremely strong.

Due to many factors—

The Robber Clan holds a unique position among the twelve great peak clans.

Least in number, yet the most threatening.

…

Insect Race battlefield base.

One by one, huge Insect Race Hives were floating in space, and one after another, ferocious Insect Race Warriors were quickly bred.

At the same time.

The wills of the Insect Race Hives were interweaving, communicating efficiently.

“Bing 387, you specifically breed Insect Race Warriors who have reached Level Eleven Perfect in defense.”

“Bing 778, you specifically breed Insect Race Warriors who have reached Level Eleven Perfect in attacking.”

“Bing 1923, you specifically breed Insect Race Warriors who have reached Level Eleven Perfect in Soul Illusion.”

…

Streams of enormous mental wills were continuously transmitted between the major hives.

Compared to other peak clan’s combat styles, the Insect Race has only one.

That is the ‘Sea of Bugs’.

Continuously breeding Insect Race Warriors with different focal points, and under the control of the Insect Race Hive, perfectly combining and cooperating.

An Insect Race Warrior who has reached Level Eleven Perfect in defense, in front of other Level Eleven Perfect, might just be a live target, posing no threat.

But if you add an Insect Race Warrior who has reached Level Eleven Perfect in attack, along with another who has reached Level Eleven Perfect in Soul Illusion, and so on.

Under the control of the Insect Race Hive, perfectly cooperating…

Even if they are not as good as Level Eleven Perfect, they are probably not far off.

If this number is multiplied by ten thousand, a hundred thousand, a million, even Level Eleven Perfect would feel terrified.
